holdout_policy: Run selected card and p000 only once as a fixed two-repeat batch; never revise using holdout
selection: Maximum development screenshot correct sum, then fewer false accepts, then p001_p002
gate: Screenshot paired cluster bootstrap 95% accuracy improvement lower > 0; false accepts do not increase in either repeat
original_input: Replace primary image with clean source and projected bbox; identical production three-image assembler, no fourth image
failure: Never score failed calls as false; no pass if incomplete
